latest.headline: Nvidia CEO turmoil drags chips; MU indicated down about 4%
latest.tldr: Reports that Nvidia's board may remove Jensen Huang have NVDA down about 8% pre-market and Nasdaq 100 futures down about 0.8%, pulling MU to $780.50 (−3.8% from Wednesday's $811.30 close) with no Micron-specific news.
